owner_creation.analysis: cp: The pointer is a non-owning cursor into cmdbuf, initially null and set to the array base by cmd_reset before editing.

aliases_escapes.analysis: cp: Step/repaint helpers copy cp into raw np/save_cp/old_cp aliases and update through pointer arguments; none retains ownership of command bytes.
